description: Agent eval for the DSDS site (plan item 8). Each task is given to an agent with only the Markdown pages in evals/context/. The agent's answer is scored by evals/score.js: the document must validate with no errors, and each check must hold. Paths use dots and [n]. Ops: sourceToken (the `source` pointer resolves, in the task's `dtcg` file, to a token with that $value; given null, only that it resolves), eq, exists, notExists, len>= (value is a number), contains (string), some (array has an element matching the partial object), deepContains (the values of every `checks` key anywhere in the document contain the string).

tasks.prompt: Write a valid DSDS component entry for a checkbox. It needs kind, id `checkbox`, name, and description; one guidelines section (for: all) with two items, one `must` and one `should`, each with a statement; and one variant trait called `size` with kind enum and three values (small, medium, large), each with an id and a description.

Write a valid DSDS token entry for `color.action.primary`. Its value lives in the DTCG file `./tokens.dtcg.json`, at the path `#/color/action/primary`. That file is in your context folder, and it holds this token. Include a description.

Fix this DSDS token entry so it validates. Keep its meaning. The DTCG file `./tokens.dtcg.json` is in your context folder; it holds this token's value at `#/color/action/primary`, so the entry should point at that value rather than state it. Output the corrected document only.

```yaml
kind: token
id: Color Action Primary
name: Primary action
tokenType: Color
value: "#0055ff"
description: Main action color.
```

Write a valid DSDS theme entry called `theme-dark`. It is a dark colour scheme that inherits from `theme-light`, which already exists in the project. Its DTCG tokens are in `./themes/dark.dtcg.json`. Include a description.

Write a valid DSDS base document: schemaVersion set to the version these pages describe, a name, and entries. Its shared list has one entry, `shared-a11y`, with an item `focus-visible` (level must, statement "Keep the focus ring visible."). Its entries list has one component, `button`, with one guidelines section (for: all) whose only item reuses `shared-a11y#focus-visible` through a same-as ref and has no statement of its own.

Write the complete `button` component entry (kind, id, name, description) with one trait, `variant` (traitType variant, kind enum), and three values: `primary`, `secondary`, and `primary-blue`. `primary-blue` has been renamed to `primary`, so mark it deprecated and name its successor.

Write a component entry for `card` with one guidelines item (level must) that is checked automatically. The check is the test file `tests/card.a11y.test.ts`. The item cites the WCAG 2.2 page https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/focus-visible.html as its evidence.

Write a component entry for `dialog`. Its description mentions the `button` component with an inline link. Its one guideline item tells people to keep the focus ring visible, with an inline link to the rule `shared-a11y#focus-visible`. A dialog is built from a button, so declare that as a pointer too.

This component document was written for DSDS 0.21. Upgrade it to 0.23 so it validates. Keep its meaning, and output the corrected document only.

```yaml
kind: component
id: tooltip
name: Tooltip
description: Shows extra info on hover.
purpose: Gives context for an icon without a label.
related:
  - to: popover
    rel: related
metadata:
  status: {status: stable}
  context: Used in toolbars.
sections:
  - kind: guidelines
    for: all
    items:
      - level: should
        statement: Show on hover and focus.
```

Write a component entry for `toast`. Give it a steps section, for: agent, with three checklist steps with ids: `set-duration` (Set the duration), `check-contrast` (Check the contrast), and `test-screen-reader` (Test with a screen reader). Add a guidelines item (level must, checkedBy manual) that is verified by the first step: point its checks at that step with a `to` pointer.

Write a component entry for `avatar`, implemented on two platforms: React in `src/Avatar.tsx` and iOS in `ios/Avatar.swift`. Its API is documented in a generated Custom Elements Manifest at `dist/custom-elements.json`. Include a description and one guidelines item.

Write a component entry for `button`. It has a `size` trait (traitType variant, kind enum, values small and large) and a `loading` state (traitType state, kind boolean). Add a combo that forbids `size.small` together with `loading`, at level must-not.
